entities.name: Among the account opened, how many female customers who were born before 1950 and stayed in Sokolov?

properties.sql:
-- Count female clients born before 1950 residing in Sokolov that have an account opened
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_customers
FROM client AS c
JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp AS dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account AS a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov'

entities.name: What is the gender of the oldest client who opened his/her account in the highest average salary branch?

entities.name: For the client who applied the biggest loan, what was his/her first amount of transaction after opened the account?

properties.sql:
SELECT t.amount
FROM trans AS t
JOIN account AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp AS dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE t.date >= a.date
  AND a.account_id = (
        SELECT l.account_id
        FROM loan AS l
        ORDER BY l.amount DESC
        LIMIT 1
      )
ORDER BY t.date ASC, t.trans_id ASC
LIMIT 1

entities.name: For loan amount less than USD100,000, what is the percentage of accounts that is still running with no issue.

properties.sql:

FROM loan AS l
WHERE l.amount < 100000

properties.sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.account_id) FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN district AS T3 ON T1.district_id = T3.district_id WHERE T3.A3 = 'Prague'

entities.name: The average unemployment ratio of 1995 and 1996, which one has higher percentage?

properties.sql: SELECT DISTINCT IIF(AVG(A13) > AVG(A12), '1996', '1995') FROM district

entities.name: List out the no. of districts that have female average salary is more than 6000 but less than 10000?

properties.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id)
FROM district AS d
JOIN client AS c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000

entities.name: How many male customers who are living in North Bohemia have average salary greater than 8000?

properties.sql:
-- Male clients living in North Bohemia whose district has an average salary greater than 8000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_male_clients
FROM (
    SELECT c.client_id
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'M'
      AND d.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
    GROUP BY c.client_id
    HAVING AVG(d.A11) > 8000
) AS t

entities.name: List out the account numbers of clients who are youngest and have highest average salary?

properties.sql:
-- Account numbers of the youngest client, restricted to the district with the highest average salary
SELECT a.account_id
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account AS a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
ORDER BY c.birth_date DESC, d.A11 DESC
LIMIT 1

entities.name: How many customers who choose statement of weekly issuance are Owner?

properties.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.client_id)
FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND T2.type = 'OWNER'

entities.name: List out the id number of client who choose statement of issuance after transaction are Disponent?

properties.sql: SELECT T2.client_id FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND T2.type = 'DISPONENT'

entities.name: Among the accounts who have approved loan date in 1997, list out the accounts that have the lowest approved amount and choose weekly issuance statement.

properties.sql:
SELECT a.account_id
FROM account AS a
JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
ORDER BY l.amount ASC
LIMIT 1

entities.name: Among the accounts who have loan validity more than 12 months, list out the accounts that have the highest approved amount and have account opening date in 1993.

properties.sql:
SELECT a.account_id
FROM account AS a
JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1
